title: About - Runa Okonkwo
text:
I am Runa Okonkwo. I co-founded Quarrystone Labs in 2016 and I run the platform team there, which means I spend most of my week on the developer platform and on the people who build against it.

Quarrystone Labs raised its first outside money from Foundry Seed in 2019, and that seed round is still the one I point new founders at when they ask what a patient investor looks like.

I have lived in Austin since 2014. The company has been remote-first from its first week, and I have written more than I meant to about how that changes the shape of an engineering organisation.

Most of my public writing is about how a team that sells to engineers should price, document and support what it ships. I think a pricing page is a moral document and I will argue about that for longer than anyone wants me to.

The short version: platform work, remote teams, and the unglamorous parts of selling software to people who read the source.
